item.title: Chatham-Kent police opt out of federal gun buyback program
item.description: The Chatham‑Kent Police Service has decided not to participate in the federal government's assault‑style firearms compensation program.

item.description: A bail plan is in the works for a woman accused of starting a fire that destroyed multi-unit residential building in Blenheim this month.

item.title: Five charged after suspected fentanyl seized in raid
item.description: Five people are charged after Chatham-Kent police seized suspected fentanyl in a raid earlier Wednesday. Police searched a residence on St. Clair Street and seized about 86.5 grams of suspected fentanyl, a BB gun, digital scales, packaging materials and cellphones. item.title: Senior accused in Chatham apartment fire returns to court Feb. 3
item.description: A Chatham senior accused of arson after a fire at a Chatham housing complex last week now has a lawyer and a bail plan in the works.

item.title: Local roundup: Konecny leads Flyers; Carleton top scorer; Cougars host sign-up
item.description: Clachan’s Travis Konecny leads the Philadelphia Flyers in goals, assists and points after getting a hat trick Wednesday in a 5-3 loss to the Columbus Blue Jackets.
